title: Inquiry into the Department of Defence Annual Report 2024-25
basis: The automatic match gave OTD 15729, which is the Law Enforcement committee's examination of the AFP annual report — a wrong link on a public register. The Speaker's schedule dates this row 29/1/26, and the only Foreign Affairs, Defence and Trade report tabled that day is OTD 14745, "Inquiry into the Department of Defence Annual Report 2023-24". No report named 2024-25 exists on the Tabled Documents register; the year in the Speaker's schedule appears to be an error.
